ChapterResult.description:
What recording a lesson or a game answers: the chapter, and whether it gave a heart.

A heart comes from a replay, up to a daily cap (ADR 0009). Past the cap,
or the first time, `heart_earned` is false and nothing else changes.
ChapterResult.title: ChapterResult

ChapterState.description: A chapter's lesson and its games, always listed `memory`, then `match`.
ChapterState.title: ChapterState

LearnedPlace.description: A place where the child has seen at least one lesson, with those lessons' words.
LearnedPlace.title: LearnedPlace

LearnedWords.description:
Every word the child has learned, by place, for the Riječi tab (#232).

A word is learned once its chapter's lesson is seen, the same rule as
`ProgressCounts.words_learned`, so the words listed add up to that count.
LearnedWords.title: LearnedWords

NextPlace.description: The first open place with a lesson still to see: "Posjeti Kotor i sakupi još 4 riječi".
NextPlace.title: NextPlace

Player.description: A child on the account: the `Profile` with its id, and whether this session plays as it.
Player.title: Player

PracticeResult.description:
What recording a practice game answers: whether it gave a heart (ADR 0009).

Practice changes no lock, sticker, star or count of words. Past the daily
cap `heart_earned` is false.
PracticeResult.title: PracticeResult

Profile.description: The current account's child profile. Fields stay null until it is set up.
Profile.title: Profile

ProfileUpdate.description: Sets the whole profile. The name is trimmed before its length is checked.
ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate

ProgressCounts.description:
What the child has collected, for the Ja screen and the grown-ups area (#175).

The server counts them, so the frontend never does (ADR 0005).
ProgressCounts.title: ProgressCounts

number.description: Recording number (1-300), also the audio file name.
number.title: Number

post.description: A practice game from the Riječi tab, played to the end (ADR 0009).

get.description: No session needed: the sign-up page sends this version back (ADR 0008).
The child's learned words by place, for the Riječi tab (#232).
